title: Database connection pool saturation runbook
content: When active database connections reach the connection pool maximum, new requests wait for a connection and application latency increases. Check pool capacity, active connections, waiting requests, and connection hold time. Increase capacity only after validating database capacity.

title: Login latency investigation runbook
content: Compare login P95 latency with its baseline, inspect successful requests with high duration, and correlate application logs with telemetry using the simulation correlation ID.

title: Human approval safety runbook
content: A remediation recommendation remains pending until a human approves it. Rejection must leave system state unchanged, and every decision must be recorded in the audit history.
